consumers.finalUseResponsibility: The existing SQLite owner reacquires the exact selected cut before candidate publication; checkpoint persistence and any later mutation remain with the existing compact owner.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Differentiate missing or stale source rows, invalid retention metadata, construction-budget failure and owner unavailability; a candidate never grants checkpoint-write authority.

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: The V2 ingress verifies the complete revision-bound source set and delegates to existing compiler admission; the provider/model use owner must still bind and revalidate the compiled payload before physical send.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Keep omitted or substituted source revisions, unverified or inactive events, compiler admission failure and provider-boundary staleness distinct from owner corruption.
requiredExecutionEvidence: legacy product caller and revision-bound V2 ingress comparison

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: Federation authorization and each source owner retain source-currentness; the final model-input owner must revalidate the aggregated selection.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Preserve denied, unavailable, partial and omitted coverage without leaking denied-record existence or relabelling transport failure as an empty success.

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: The retrieval owner supplies the exact cut; Agentd and the native worker own final-use revalidation of ID, revision, content and retrieval-context bindings.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Distinguish missing records, stale candidates, invalid request bounds, optional ranker failure and actual owner-store failure.
requiredExecutionEvidence: exact ID revision and content binding
native worker fresh and stale context cases

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: The runtime scope/generation owner and inference effect owner must validate revocation, cancellation and selected model state at use.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Keep stale generation, revoked input, cancellation and inference-owner unavailability distinct from malformed cognitive projections.

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: Objective admission and durable publication stay with their existing owners; any downstream effect owner must bind the admitted objective and current context before use.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Separate stale cognitive input, objective admission failure, publication failure and downstream final-use rejection.

consumers.finalUseResponsibility: Request-local utility evaluation remains deny-all; the independent authorization owner controls effects and the authenticated NDU owner controls any durable mutation.
consumers.errorMappingRequirement: Separate stale planning state, invalid bounds, missing uncertainty axes and unavailable independent authorization from ordinary utility comparison outcomes.
